The phone remains opaque and rigid in the left hand, with a soft neutral-white blank screen and warm skin tones. Preserve her 32-year-old face, headwrap, sofa and lighting. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.000 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.
